## Checklist

- [ ] PR title follows [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org) (e.g. `feat: add gemini provider`)
- [ ] Tests added or updated
- [ ] `pnpm lint`, `pnpm typecheck` and `pnpm test` pass locally
- [ ] Changeset added with `pnpm changeset` (skip for internal-only changes)
- [ ] Docs updated (README, `--help`) if behavior changed
